status.evidence: According to Companies House and a Constellation Software Inc. report, Mobil Information Systems UK Ltd remains active under company number 05749188 and is listed among Constellation Software's group entities.

Mobil Information Systems UK Ltd.label: Mobil Information Systems UK Ltd (subsidiary of Total Specific Solutions)

claims.claim: Mobil Information Systems UK Ltd reports that its 4G-connected vehicle tracking devices update location telemetry data every 30 to 60 seconds when moving, utilizing a standard mobile network SIM to transmit coordinates to its secure cloud platform.

The company reports the development and deployment of its proprietary "MST Web" platform, which provides fleet operators with real-time tracking, driver behavior scoring, vehicle maintenance reminders, and over 50 customizable management reports, as documented on the Mobil-i product specifications page.

The company introduced "Fleet Emissions Intelligence" live into its platform to calculate real-world greenhouse gas trajectories utilizing data frameworks such as TRL PPR987 idle rates and European Commission guidelines, according to its product announcement.
claims.note: The utilization of European Commission guidelines is not stated in the source text.

claims.claim: The company reports offering the Queclink CV200XEU/XNA LTE Cat 6 dash camera, which integrates AI-powered driver monitoring systems (DMS), advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS), and real-time GPS tracking capabilities.
The company provides a scalable multi-camera DVR hardware system that supports configurations up to 12 channels for comprehensive vehicle coverage alongside continuous high-definition recording.
claims.corrected: The company provides a scalable multi-camera DVR hardware system that supports configurations up to 8 channels for comprehensive vehicle coverage alongside continuous high-definition recording.

claims.claim: Mobil Information Systems UK Ltd officially achieved the international ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification for its information security management system, establishing a formally recognized framework for data protection and risk management.
The company reports that its fleet management and GPS vehicle tracking solutions are suited to accommodate fleets of any size, specifically scaling from 2 to 2,000 vehicles.

Public procurement data confirms that Mobil Information Systems Ltd won contracts with public sector bodies, such as a 2023 fleet tracking system contract with Sligo County Council and an asset management contract with Carlow County Council.
claims.source: TenderMatch Ireland (https://tendermatch.ie/suppliers/069cdbc2-d499-7ee0-8000-70759248d178-mobil-information-systems-ltd/) and eTenders Gov Ireland (https://www.etenders.gov.ie/epps/cft/prepareViewCfTWS.do?resourceId=2547257)

claims.claim: UK government registry filings show that Mobil Information Systems UK Ltd is an active private limited company incorporated on March 20, 2006, with its registered office in Caerphilly Business Park, Caerphilly, Wales.
Open corporate data platforms like Endole report that Mobil Information Systems UK Ltd qualifies as a small company with a turnover under £1 million and a balance sheet under £500,000.
claims.corrected: Open corporate data platforms like Endole report that Mobil Information Systems UK Ltd qualifies as a micro company with a turnover under £1 million and a balance sheet under £500,000.

claims.claim: The company reports an "all-under-one-roof" business model where it develops its own software in-house and utilizes its own engineering team for installations rather than relying on external distributor networks.

Mobil Information Systems UK Ltd operates an active registered entity in Wales at Caerphilly Business Park under company number 05749188, classification code 61300 for satellite telecommunications activities.
The company maintains its UK physical presence with an active registered office located at 4b Caerphilly Business Park, Caerphilly, Mid Glamorgan, Wales.

status.evidence: According to Companies House and recent corporate press releases, VisionTrack Limited is active and operates as a part of the Markerstudy Group.

claims.claim: VisionTrack's cloud-based IoT video telematics platform, Autonomise.ai, collects and processes real-time data from more than 115,000 connected devices, averaging 3.5 million driver miles per day and 292 billion data points annually according to official company documentation.
claims.note: The figure of 292 billion data points annually corresponds to an older 75,000+ device metric, and no single source verifies it applies concurrently to the 115,000+ connected devices milestone.

claims.claim: The company reports that its VT3000-AI hardware solution utilizes a built-in 4G network connection to transmit real-time telemetry and video analytics, supporting instant cloud uploads of advanced driver assist system (ADAS) and driver status monitoring (DSM) alerts.
claims.note: Documentation shows that 4G connectivity and driver status monitoring (DSM) are handled via separate external modular components (VT-C26-IPC and VT-DSM-AI) rather than being built-in to the base VT3000-AI hardware unit itself.

claims.claim: An anonymized regional logistics company utilized VisionTrack's vehicle data and software coaching to monitor patterns of harsh braking, achieving a 35% reduction in these events within six months to improve road safety and lower maintenance costs, according to a case study on the Geotab Marketplace.
claims.note: The exact details specifying an 'anonymized regional logistics company' and the 'within six months' timeframe are unconfirmed by the cited Geotab source.

claims.claim: An anonymized United Kingdom fleet with over 500 vehicles implemented VisionTrack's AI-enabled cameras and software analytics, resulting in a 71% reduction in distracted driving events through driver behavior analysis, as reported by VisionTrack.

The company reports a comprehensive hardware suite that includes its VT3600-AI dashcam with integrated Driver Status Monitoring (DSM) and Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS), alongside multi-channel ruggedized Mobile Digital Video Recorders (MDVRs) such as the 8-channel VT6.2, and blind spot detection sensors.

Tonbridge School implemented VisionTrack's hardware solution by deploying forward and rear-facing vehicle cameras, ruggedized anti-vibration MDVRs, and AI-enabled dashcams across its minibus fleet to support real-time vehicle tracking and internal passenger safety.

A July 2026 case study detailing VisionTrack's deployment for Tonbridge School's minibus fleet confirms that its Autonomise.ai platform meets GDPR requirements and holds third-party verified ISO 27001 and Cyber Essentials Plus certifications.

A September 2026 fleet deployment project with Loomis UK confirms the implementation of VisionTrack's video telematics and Autonomise.ai platform across a 500+ vehicle fleet, utilizing a cloud architecture on Microsoft Azure that adheres to GDPR, Cyber Essentials Plus, and ISO 27001 standards.
claims.note: Autonomise.ai platform, Microsoft Azure cloud architecture, GDPR, Cyber Essentials Plus, and ISO 27001 standards

claims.claim: VisionTrack partnered with software provider Internetum to complete a comprehensive upgrade of its Autonomise.ai platform, moving from a legacy monolithic setup to a Microsoft Azure microservices-based architecture that utilizes Azure Functions and internal APIs to scale independently and maintain vendor-agnostic data compatibility across hardware providers like Streamax, ATrack, Howen, and Aplicom.

VisionTrack features an API-driven enterprise integration with Fleetio's fleet management software, enabling automated daily transfers of live vehicle location coordinates and odometer readings from its platform directly into the Fleetio system.

As announced on 16 September 2026, Loomis UK selected VisionTrack to deploy its front- and driver-facing AI video telematics cameras, Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS), Driver Safety Monitoring (DSM), and NARA AI assistant across its fleet of more than 500 vehicles.

As reported by the company on 21 May 2025, VisionTrack renewed its long-standing fleet safety management partnership with Fleeto, a London PCO hire company, to equip its fleet with 4G front-facing cameras over a 3-year contract duration.

According to filing data from the UK Companies House register, VisionTrack Limited achieved a latest reported annual turnover of £18.4 million, establishing a financial net worth of £5.9 million and cash at bank of £2.1 million.
claims.note: Turnover of £18.4 million, net worth of £5.9 million, and cash of £2.1 million could not be confirmed in the provided registry aggregates.

claims.claim: The company reports in a historical corporate announcement that the rapid adoption of its cloud-based vehicle CCTV and video telematics solutions within the UK fleet market resulted in an annual revenue increase exceeding 250% during 2018.

VisionTrack announced a strategic partnership with driver risk management specialist Applied Driving in May 2023 to integrate the Riskmapp web-application with VisionTrack’s IoT platform, Autonomise.ai, allowing commercial fleets to deploy targeted training verified by its computer vision tool.
claims.corrected: VisionTrack announced a strategic partnership with driver risk management specialist Applied Driving in May 2023 to integrate the Riskmapp web-application with VisionTrack’s IoT platform, Autonomise.ai, allowing commercial fleets to deploy targeted training verified by its computer vision tool, NARA.
claims.note: The training tool is verified by VisionTrack's AI-powered post-analysis tool named NARA, not a generic computer vision tool description.
claims.source: VisionTrack and Applied Driving Joint Press Release (May 2023)

claims.claim: VisionTrack established joint proposition and distribution partnerships within the insurance channel with UK entities including BDElite, Cubit Insurance, and Collingwood Insurance Services to link its video telematics and platform functionality with active claims management and fleet underwriting workflows.
The company reports deploying more than 125,000 connected camera devices and processing 3.5 million daily driver miles on its Autonomise.ai cloud IoT platform.

Loomis UK announced in September 2026 that it had selected VisionTrack to deploy front- and driver-facing AI cameras featuring Advanced Driver Assistance Systems across a fleet of more than 500 vehicles.

VisionTrack Limited operates its primary UK head office at 2 Chapman Way, High Brooms Industrial Estate, Tunbridge Wells, Kent, with official corporate registry records placing its registered address in Sevenoaks, Kent.

The company reports its operational customer services, technical support, and commissioning support phone lines are staffed from 9:00am to 5:00pm, Monday through Friday, alongside a distinct morning window on Saturdays from 9:00am to 1:00pm.
